item.title: Handel on the News get well Mike cartoon
item.description:
Mike Nolan, KFI traffic reporter and contributor to the KFI Handel morning show was involved in a plane crash.  Nolan is a former Marine, and excellent radio personality.  I listen to this show quite a bit while I am doing my artwork.  I decided to send a get well image to cheer him up.

MIKE’S CRASH FEATURED ON KFI WEB BLOG (kinda cool)

item.title: Talk Radio Comic
item.description: I often times listen to talk radio while I work on my various graphic projects.  One of my favorite shows is the ‘Bill Handel’ show.  Rich Marotta is a superiorly entertaining and talented voice on the show.  There is a lot to love about this man and his amazing career, but at times the listeners and others on the show don’t show very much respect for his well educated opinion.
